newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits quietly steady in evening.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits quietly steady in evening.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were quietly steady on Wednesday in moderate trade, dealers said.
"The market was quietly steady while traders awaited new positions for Friday's U.S payroll employment numbers," a local dealer said.
"The maturity period for one-month term rate is coming up and traders are waiting for further direction," said another dealer.
The April leading indicators forecast in the U.S for factory orders showed an increase of 0.8 percent compared to a 1.6 percent contraction in its previous report.
Day-to-day and week-fixed rates remained unchanged from Tuesday's common 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent, respectively.

Among term rates, one month was unchanged from Tuesday's 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent. Five months was unchanged at 5-13/16 5-11/16 percent, six months eased by 1/16 point to 5-15/16 5-13/16 percent and twelve months remained unchanged at 6-3/16 6-1/16 percent.
